How the model works

implied = TVL × category multiple × growth × maturity × chains

  • Category multiple. Median market-cap / TVL of the category’s live tokens, shrunk toward the global median with a prior of 2, clamped to 0.05–5. A lone live token’s ratio is winsorized to the 90th percentile (2.9747) before shrinkage, so one outlier cannot price a category. A category with no live token uses the global median.
  • Growth. 1 + clamp(7d change, −50…+150%) / 100 × 0.6.
  • Maturity. 0.6 + 0.4 × min(age, 1460 days) / 1460.
  • Chains. 1 + 0.04 per extra chain, capped at five extras.
  • Floor & cap. Implied value is at least $1 and at most $100,000,000,000,000.
  • Robustness. An independent log-log fit of market cap on TVL puts the same three protocols on top (Spearman 0.76); gas figures are rounded public fee ranges, Nov 2026.
